assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game interior art direction for ASHFALL
Primary request: A wide, premium HD blocky 3D game concept triptych showing three small roofless isometric cutaway interiors, each separated by a slim dark gutter. Build believable lived-in original space-western rooms with chunky premium voxel-like meshes and physically believable material microdetail, matching the attached exterior game screenshot's overall quality, scale, camera and warm/cool balance.
Input image 1: style reference only; create entirely new interior compositions, do not copy the UI or exterior layout.
Left room: The Still Ember, a compact 7.6 by 7.2 metre cantina in ochre masonry. Back-wall bar with bronze beverage coils, tiny colored bottles, counter stools, warm leather booths along side walls, amber recessed lanterns, utility conduits and broad ivory enamel wall plates. Center remains spacious enough to walk. An open heavy sliding door shows a little rainy street beyond.
Middle room: Kestrel Repair House, compact 7.6 by 6 metre industrial workshop. Gunmetal tool benches, old mechanical parts in orderly racks, an original boxy scout chassis under a practical work lamp, a small lift and repair arms, ribbed dark bronze wall panels, ivory enamel plates with worn seams. Sparse warm task lamps balanced against cool ambient. Clear walkable center and open sliding entrance.
Right room: The Oath Archive, a 10 by 5.8 metre cool cyan chamber. Central compact holochart with fine glowing star points and simple orbital lines, restrained blue emissive light, original helmet and armor relics in wall niches, dark bronze framed data cabinets and stone benches, a few amber votive lamps. Deep ochre masonry, no recognizable franchise symbols.
In each room show one small original helmeted 1.85 metre traveler in weathered gray armor and a rusty ochre flight cloak, and their 0.78 metre four-legged boxy cream and teal companion Tallow with a warm glowing core. They must be correctly scaled to furniture and room; these are playable rooms, not oversized cavernous halls. Readable silhouettes, no familiar movie costume shapes.
Composition: same high-isometric camera across all three rooms, roof completely removed and two front walls cut low so the interiors are clear. Wide 16:9 image. Detailed but navigable spaces, museum-diorama clarity, cinematic restrained haze, subtle worn stone floor sheen near entries, physically believable shadows and light falloff. Sad but welcoming, lived-in mythic grit.
Constraints: wholly original designs. No Lucasfilm or Disney characters, exact costumes, existing ship shapes, emblems, or trademarked names. No text, labels, logos, UI or watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless tileable physically based albedo texture for original space-western interior wall meshes
Primary request: Square flat orthographic two-dimensional surface texture showing worn warm ivory enamel wall plates with dark bronze and gunmetal ribbed inset panels. Quiet broad rectangular plates of several proportions, narrow practical seams, tiny weathered rivet heads, subtle rubbed corners, fine gray and ochre grunge. Broad ivory surfaces should dominate about two thirds of the tile; a few narrow dark metallic ribbed strips add industrial detail. Premium hand-authored HD blocky game material, believable weathering in a sheltered cantina or repair shop.
Composition: edge-to-edge material swatch, perfectly flat, repeatable seamlessly on all four edges, no perspective and no objects. Preserve clear large plate shapes from a distance.
Lighting: neutral diffuse albedo color only, no directional highlights, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion or baked illumination.
Constraints: no text, numbers, logos, symbols, emblems or watermark. No familiar franchise design. No transparent regions.
